GMV BONUS EVENT
$10,000 GMV

$1,000 BONUS

Based on the total GMV from all SIOT product videos posted during the campaign period.

Campaign Period

June 17 – July 2

SIOT will be actively participating in TikTok Shop’s Deals For You Days campaign during this period.

Bonus Reward

$1,000 Bonus

If your SIOT videos generate over $10,000 in total GMV during the campaign period, you’ll receive a $1,000 bonus.

How It Works

Post more, grow more

  • Upload SIOT product videos during the campaign period.
  • All SIOT product video GMV will be counted together.
  • There is no limit on the number of videos you can post.
Boost Opportunity

Best time to drive higher GMV

SIOT is planning additional campaign support, including promotional exposure and boosting for strong-performing content.

How Winners Are Selected

Most SIOT videos uploaded

Creators are ranked based on the number of eligible SIOT videos uploaded during the campaign period.

Campaign Period

June 17 – July 2

Only videos posted during this period will be counted for the Discord-only bonus event.

More Videos

More chances to win

There is no limit on the number of videos you can upload. The more quality SIOT videos you post, the higher your chance of reaching the Top 5.

How To Participate

Share your video links

  • Join the SIOT Discord server.
  • Upload SIOT TikTok Shop videos.
  • Share your links in #share-your-contents-here 😎.

Important Rules

Please make sure each video is original and meaningful

  • Videos must contain original and meaningful content.
  • Repetitive low-effort uploads may not be counted.
  • AI-generated or duplicated videos may be excluded.
  • Simple product-only clips may not qualify.
  • Final eligibility is determined by the SIOT team.
